## The subagent detail stops lying about order, position, and identity

Four reported symptoms, one screen, all fixed — each verified against the previous code by a test that fails without its fix, plus genuine screenshot captures.

- **Thinking and tools interleave again.** The stream fold used to emit every thinking block before every tool call, so a child reasoning between two tool runs read as three thinkings followed by two tools. Items now emit in wire order: think → tool → think → tool, exactly like the main chat.
- **No more double tool rows.** The same call rendered twice — once when it started (stream row), once when it finished (session row). The session row is now authoritative the moment it renders the call; the stream row covers only the in-flight window, then hands over.
- **Finished runs open at the top.** Selecting a finished child pinned the view to the tail, hiding the first thinking section off-screen — twice over, via scroll-on-open *and* the scrollbox's sticky-bottom mount. Finished/stopped/unresponsive transcripts now open on their first section; live runs still follow the tail.
- **Same-id agents never merge.** A nested grandchild could share its ancestor's bare id (the runtime only guaranteed per-process uniqueness), collapsing two agents into one row with the wrong transcript. Identity now leads with the control dir, so each run is its own row; routing is untouched.
- **Edit expansion shows Changes.** Stream-built tool items never received diffs, so expanding an edit on a subagent showed nothing. Diffs now backfill from the session's tool result, and the Changes section renders as in main chat.
- **Idle residents stop advertising stale context.** A done-but-resident implementer permanently showed its frozen window usage. Those rows keep the (still true) tool count and drop the frozen number — same policy as the earlier resident-age removal.
- **Restarted PiTTy keeps finished transcripts.** Finished runs are discovered from prior sessions even when the reloaded conversation holds no spawn tools, with session-backed transcripts.

## Screenshots

Four genuine 1400×1028 captures in `docs/screenshots/` (each with `.ansi`/`.html` source): `subagent-interleave` (think → tool → think), `subagent-inline-header` (one-row Context/Model/Thinking), `subagent-finished-top` (tall finished transcript opening on its first section), `subagent-restart` (previous-session run listed with zero spawn tools).

## Validation

- Complete local suites for the touched areas: **141 passed** (`test/subagents.test.ts`), **132 passed** (`test/render.test.tsx`), 0 failures; typecheck clean.
- Requires `@mistrjirka/pi-subagent` **0.5.1** for the runtime half of id uniqueness (ancestor-chain seeding) and the stop-suppression race fix; PiTTy degrades gracefully on older runtimes.
